decision_conditions: The proposed two storey side extension, by virtue of its width, siting, bulk and proximity to the site boundary would appear visually intrusive, incongruous, overly dominant and appear as an incongruous extension that is out of keeping with the character and appearance of the host building and the surrounding area of which it forms part, contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3 and D4, of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and DMD6, DMD8, DMD14 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed side extension by reason of its height, bulk, scale, and siting on the shared boundary with Nos. 1 and 3 Littlebury Street would cause significant overbearing, overshadowing, heightened sense of enclosure and loss of light impacts to rear habitable room windows at this un-attached property. The proposed side extension is therefore contrary to Policies CP 4 and CP 30 of the Enfield Core Strategy 2010 and DMD 8, DMD 11 and DMD 14 of the Enfield Development Management Document 2014.

The proposed development has failed to provide sufficient flood compensation for a 1 in 100-year (+17% climate change) event which will increase the risk of flooding on site and elsewhere. The proposal is therefore contrary to Section 14 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), to policies SI12 and SI 13 of the London Plan (2021), to policies CP21 and CP28 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), to policies DMD59, DMD60 and DMD61 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), and the Enfield Strategic Flood Risk Assessment.
description: Single storey rear extension and part single storey, part two storey side extension.
